title: Chaos in the near-horizon dynamics of the dyonic $\rm{AdS_4}$-Reissner-Nordström black hole
summary: We investigate the chaos in the dynamics of a probe massless particle confined by the harmonic potential near the horizon of the dyonic $\rm{AdS_4}$-Reissner-Nordström black hole. The total energy of the particle, chemical potential and magnetic field in this system serving as independently adjustable parameters tune nonlinearity and phase-space structure.
